title: NearWave Invited to Present at ECBO23 European Conferences on Biomedical Optics
summary: NearWave founder and CEO, Roy Stillwell, had the honor of speaking at the European Conferences on Biomedical Optics on NearWave Imager: the first entirely handheld real-time frequency-domain near-infrared spectroscopy imaging system.
body_markdown:
NearWave founder and CEO, Roy Stillwell, had the honor of speaking at the European Conferences on Biomedical Optics on *NearWave Imager: the first entirely handheld real-time frequency-domain near-infrared spectroscopy imaging system* .
